name: downloads
description: Download files from URLs, install packages (pip/npm/winget), and search package registries.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a URL to a file. Default destination: downloads/<filename> in the workspace.

tools.name: install_package
tools.description: Install a package with pip, npm or winget. Use when a needed library/tool is missing.

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search PyPI or npm for a package to find the right name/version.
